title: Q3 Strategic Sprint Lanes for Private/VPC Enterprise Deliverables
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: Consolidated plan that breaks Q3 deliverables for Private/VPC/on-prem into three sprint lanes: Core Platform (SLA/Routing/Autoscale), Compliance & Ops (KMS, Audit, Upgrade Runbooks), and Customer Activation (onboarding templates, compatibility tests, activation cohorts). Goal: define minimally viable slices per lane that can be delivered across two tranches, with clear acceptance criteria, key dependencies, and a rollback/runbook for each tranche. This ticket coordinates PM, Eng, Design and Solutions to translate OKRs into sprint-level commitments and triggers for sales-assisted onboarding.
acceptance_criteria: Lane milestones defined with owner, acceptance tests, and deployment window
Tranche 1 alpha: 3 pilot customers activated using the onboarding template without manual infra intervention
SLO baseline for private instances measured and documented in dashboard (latency and error rate)
KMS integration validated in staging with automated key rotation smoke test
milestones: M1: Sprint lanes workshop & stake-holder signoff (by 2026-03-10)
M2: Draft tranche-1 minimal deliverables and runbooks (by 2026-04-15)
M3: Internal canary activation and metrics collection (by 2026-05-20)
M4: Customer pilot rollouts and feedback loop (start 2026-06-01)
M5: Post-pilot retrospective & tranche-2 scope adjustments (by 2026-06-25)
decisions: Prioritize a two-tranche rollout to reduce blast radius instead of a single all-features cutover
Adopt route-by-policy defaults for private instances to reduce per-tenant config complexity
Require security review for KMS/HSM integrations before any customer pilot signoff
risks: Customer-specific network topologies may require bespoke onprem adapters (time risk)
Capacity signals for Dedicated pools may not be mature enough to trigger autoscale rules reliably
Regulatory customers will demand longer audit retention, impacting observability costs
